title: Star Escape 3D
description: Pilot a sleek starship weaving through neon asteroid rings and orbital tunnels—dodge energy barriers at hyperspeed and chase cosmic distance records.
controls: Drag left and right to bank your starship around space obstacles and collect energy boosts.

zh-CN.title: 星际逃逸 3D
zh-CN.description: 科幻炫酷 3D 星际逃逸：驾驶星际战机穿梭霓虹陨石带与太空隧道，极速闪避激光障碍刷新光年纪录！
zh-CN.controls: 左右滑动操控飞船在太空赛道灵活闪避陨石与障碍，拾取加速能量冲刺高分。
